messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: QBR planning: pipeline sync + account summary deliverables

Team —

We need to lock the QBR pipeline numbers and assemble an account-by-account pack for the exec review. High level asks below; Ive attached a simple template (QBR_account_template.xlsx) and last quarters deck for context.

What I need from each of you by EOD Thu 2026-03-26 (PST):
- Consolidated forecast row for your book (Committed vs. Best Case vs. Upside) with ARR and expected close date.
- Per-account 1-pager: short summary (status, buying committee, top risks, blockers, next steps, expected legal/proc timeline). Use the attached template.
- Highlight any OKR regressions (deal-level MQL->SQL conversion drop, demo-to-poc slippage) and any accounts that need exec unblock.

Please populate the master sheet (linked below) and drop your attached 1-pagers in the QBR folder. Ill be consolidating Friday morning and want a dry-run with Laura at 11:00 PT.

Consolidation link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1QBR-consolidation-sheet
Attachments: QBR_account_template.xlsx, prev_qbr_deck.pdf

Note on granularity: I don't need every email chain — 1-pager per account is ideal. For big deals (>$250k ARR) include contact-level notes and procurement/SC visibility.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, GTM Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: QBR planning: pipeline sync + account summary deliverables

Hannah —

Thanks for the clear ask. I started a pass on the East accounts and attached my notes (marissa_account_notes.docx). Quick highlights:
- Acme Corp (Priority): Committed $320k ARR, legal review in progress (procurement requested our SOC 2 evidence last week), next milestone: commercial PO by 04/08. Risk: procurement SLA likely 3-4 weeks.
- Innovatek: Best case $120k, procurement already white-gloved by solutions engineering, possibility to push to next quarter if contract needs custom clauses.
- Northleaf: Upside $60k but still in discovery; needs another technical session.

Ill upload 1-pagers to the QBR folder tonight and populate the sheet by Thu EOD.

Attachments: marissa_account_notes.docx

-M

Sharing my 1-pagers below (pasted) for the West book. Short summaries only (as requested):

- Zenith Media (Committed, $185k)
  - Status: Procurement sent redline; our legal and pricing team are reviewing.
  - Buying committee: VP Engineering (Priya), Head of Analytics (Ken).
  - Risk: Custom SLA ask on data retention; expect 2-week legal cycle after internal sign-off.
  - Next steps: Provide SLA appendix; demo on 03/30 with infra team.

- Acme Corp (Committed, $320k)
  - Status: Commercial terms verbally agreed; procurement requested SOC 2/attestation.
  - Buying committee: CTO (Mason), Procurement (ops@acmecorp.com).
  - Risk: Procurement timeline — likely 3 weeks once docs submitted.
  - Next steps: Jordan to push SOC 2 evidence + contract link; ask legal for expedited turnaround.

Uploading PDFs to the folder now. I flagged Acme as needing exec attention if legal can't compress the timeline.

- Aditya
